name: mock_sites
prompt:
Build local mock websites used ONLY for automated E2E tests (served on 127.0.0.1 by a test fixture). Output files: tests/mock_sites/server.py, tests/mock_sites/hana/login.html, tests/mock_sites/hana/history.html, tests/mock_sites/deel/expenses.html, tests/mock_sites/data.json. server.py: `class MockServer` context manager starting http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer on ('127.0.0.1', 0) in a daemon thread; property base_url; serves the static dirs and a JSON API: GET /api/hana/txns?from=YYYYMMDD&to=YYYYMMDD&page=N (10 rows/page) reading data.json; POST /api/deel/expenses records submissions in memory (server.deel_submissions list) and returns {ref:'EXP-'}; GET /api/state returns flags. Scenario flags settable via server.set_flag(name, value): 'hana_session_expired', 'hana_captcha', 'hana_selector_drift' (renders rows with a different table class), 'hana_empty', 'deel_session_expired', 'deel_form_error', 'deel_slow' (delay confirmation 3s). Flags are exposed to pages via GET /api/state, pages fetch it on load. Also server.reset(). hana/login.html: form with id/password inputs and button; on submit sets localStorage 'hana_logged_in'='1' and cookie, then shows element [data-testid='user-name'] and link to history. If 'hana_captcha' flag -> render
